newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco bought 100-125,000T Argentine wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Morocco bought 100-125,000T Argentine wheat - trade.

text.p: Private Moroccan operators have bought an estimated 100,000 to 125,000 tonnes of soft wheat from Argentina since early November, European grain traders said on Thursday.
The wheat, all for December delivery, was priced at between $148 and $159 per tonne, including cost and freight, they said.

On Wednesday a member of the Casablanca-based cereal importers committee said Moroccan private traders bought 40,000 tonnes of Argentine soft wheat at between $155 and $158 per tonne, cost and freight, for December delivery.
